notes: SOUND PASS ACROSS THE WHOLE GAME: real 3D sound - you can hear if a shot or footstep is in front, behind, above or below you.
Walls and floors muffle sound: gunfire, steps and zombies behind a wall or on another floor sound dull and quieter.
Every map has its own acoustics: long echoing reverb in the hospital and the airport terminal, tight rooms in the killhouse, open air with echoes on outdoor maps. Far-away gunfire sounds distant.
Guns hit harder with a fuller low end. New bullet impact and ricochet sounds on walls, and a thud when you hit a body.
A close explosion leaves your ears ringing and dulls everything for a moment; at low health the world sounds muffled.
Footsteps match the floor: tile, snow, grass, sand, wood and stairs.
Zombies have real voices now: moans, a screech when they swing and a gurgle when they die. The hospital hums, drips, creaks and has something screaming somewhere far off.
A cleaner master mix with a smoother limiter, so loud moments don't distort.
